analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md. The only visible changes in file_changes are a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and one added troubleshooting-table row near head line 3552 about a provider crash loop on pre-release macOS 27.2 builds compiled with SDK 27.2. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the full text of that row is not visible. The supplied base text covers none of the changed head ranges, so I cannot cite a head line.

The supplied base content is existing documentation of the cluster pairing and onboarding flow, link and share probe histories, owner-only ~/.darkbloom/cluster files, tensor-parallel arithmetic and placement, and served speed records. None of it was modified by this PR. It touches TB-007 (provider inference engine) and the cluster pairing and owner-only file storage described in TB-003, but it adds no new endpoints, trust boundaries, key handling, authorization changes, or encryption behavior. The documented env diagnosis switches (DARKBLOOM_QWEN_TP_EXACT_VECTORS=0, DARKBLOOM_QWEN_TP_MTP_EXACT_DRAFTS=0) are described as not forwarded by an installed owner. That is an unchanged pre-existing claim.

The retrieved T-041 definition, on the prefix-cache SSD tier, is not affected by this docs-only change. Nothing in the changed lines alters security controls or the threat-model assumptions. Remaining unknown: the truncated text of the added table row. It is a documentation troubleshooting entry only. Any related code or workaround in other batches would need its own review.
